newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Richter hits record in Budapest, London.
newsitem.headline: Richter hits record in Budapest, London.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian drugs company Richter Gedeon Rt surged to a new record high of 14,525 forints on Wednesday in what traders said stemmed from a positive market tone amid MOL's rally and Richter's good Q1 earnings released last week.
"Richter's price is surging in London and we're following amid demand from foreign investors," one trader said.
At 1034 GMT Richter traded at 14,400 forints, while in London's SEAQ it was marked at a new record high of $79 at 1033 GMT, after it opened at $75.75, unchanged from Tuesday's close.

"I think the oversubscription in MOL's global placement reminded investors that Hungarian equities are good," the trader said. "Now, those companies which had really good results, like Richter, are rising along with MOL."
The trader added he was not aware of any fresh corporate developments around Richter which could have played part in the rise of its share price.
In early trading oil company MOL shares surged more than eight percent after its subscription price in a six-times oversubscribed global offering was set at $16.25 or 2,970 forints late on Tuesday.
